skills: Up to 4 Physical and Electric hits. Mash on the 3rd to keep striking (dodging doesn't break the count); stop to go into the 4th, which is enhanced if you kept it up long enough. 40% DMG reduction on the 3rd and 4th.
Her Electric DMG builds Flash Connect Voltage; at 75% she enters Flash Connect. Moonlit Blossoms spends all of it: each 1% above 75% gives +1% DMG and +0.5% Daze to that move.
In Flash Connect, hold: five rushing attacks then a finisher for massive Electric DMG; release to finish early. A finisher timed just before a hit is a Perfect Dodge. Invulnerable on the finisher.
Rush and upward strike for Physical DMG.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Rushing attack that charges the ground and explodes for Electric DMG.
Upswing and smash for Electric DMG.
Upswing, aerial combo and a heavy smash for massive Electric DMG; hold to spend more Energy for more hits. Flows into the 3rd Basic hit.
Wide strikes for massive Electric DMG; +3% DMG per Subjugation stack on the target.
Wide strikes and a finisher for massive Electric DMG.

core.name: Eternal Seasons
core.text: Moonlit Blossoms' finisher applies 5 Subjugation (max 20), +1 per rush attack, or 10 on a Perfect Dodge; doubled on normal and elite enemies. Each stack raises the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by {0}%. Stacks reset when the Stun ends.

ability.name: Three Verses of Farewell at Yang Pass
ability.text: Basic Attacks deal +20% Daze. Each point of Impact above 120 gives +6 ATK (max 600).

mindscapes: Enters combat with full Flash Connect Voltage, and builds it 30% faster. Moonlit Blossoms at full Voltage lowers the enemy's DEF by 15% and gives her +20% CRIT Rate against it for 15s.
Subjugation is 135% as strong. At max Subjugation, her hits deal +15% Daze to that enemy.
Entering or leaving Flash Connect gives a Shield of 10% Max HP; refreshing an active Shield gives 5 Energy (once per 10s).
Moonlit Blossoms has much higher Interrupt Level and +100% CRIT DMG, and lowers Attribute DMG RES by 20% for 15s.
